notes: stream invocations include prefix-stopped passes; they are not all EOF traversals
inline text byte counts exclude metadata strings, skipped/non-inline payload decode and producer prefix classification
record extents are physical input ranges navigated, not measured read syscalls or exact parser bytes touched
method: Native Claude adapter over 20,000 synthetic messages, independent full-output oracle, late EOF metadata, fresh cache per cold pair; existing Claude/Codex sequential-page controls.
decision: Keep independent window/head routes; no coordinator or protocol change. First window remains independent of EOF metadata. Repeated tail and giant-prefix overlap remain scoped costs.
diagnostic_source: diagnostic.patch (test-only observer adaptation; no production change)
limits: Record extents exclude whole-file admission passes and are not I/O counts.
Callback counters exclude catalog lookup and source verification.
These sequential endpoint controls quantify independent work, not concurrent request scheduling or latency.
Warm heads reuse EOF metadata; repeated windows do not cache messages.
